nodes.label: pulumi CI Job (preview-only)
nodes.rationale: `up` is disabled because infra management moved to gitlab.com/unmango/pulumi/vcs; preview with refresh stays to detect drift while the migration completes.

nodes.label: graphify Knowledge Graph
nodes.rationale: Agents consult the graph before exploring files; PRs rebuild and commit it so it stays current.

nodes.label: github:token (Classic PAT)
nodes.rationale: Must be a classic PAT with repo scope because App installation tokens cannot create user-owned repos.

nodes.label: PublicRepo Component Defaults
nodes.rationale: Thin wrappers around the Pulumi GitHub provider that encode squash-only merges, signed commits, required build check and Dependabot alerts for every repo.

nodes.label: Prefer Component Wrappers over raw gh.Repository
nodes.norm_label: prefer component wrappers over raw gh.repository
nodes.rationale: Component wrappers encode the standard repo defaults; raw gh.Repository is legacy and uses .name instead of .repo.name.

nodes.label: GitHub App Auth Doesn't Work
nodes.rationale: Repos are owned by a personal user account; POST /user/repos needs user-authenticated tokens, so GitHub App installation tokens cannot work and a classic PAT is required.

nodes.label: Retirement in favor of unmango/pulumi/vcs
nodes.rationale: vcs manages both GitHub and GitLab from one Pulumi program; this repo is drift-check only and new repos go to vcs.
